title: Higher-Dimensional Semiclassical Kinetic-Energy Corrections
exact_target: Prove the predicted next-order gradient correction to semiclassical kinetic energy in dimension at least two.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005745 (OWR-14298014-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Mathematics of Many-body Fermionic Systems (2023), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2023/49, pp. 2809--2849. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The catalogue specifies proportionality but not a universal numerical coefficient or a complete error class. Those must be recovered from the source prediction, not assigned arbitrarily.
